Automation Opportunity: - Coupon auto-configured from the design template; margin-impact auto-checked; DTI-permit-gate auto-enforced
Controls: - CTL-403 (promo-rule authorization — links to VS-14); CTL-283 (DTI promo-permit compliance — review per W833); operational: VP Marketing sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-discount risk**: the coupon depth + stacking creates a net-loss transaction (customer pays less than COGS); mitigated by the margin-floor guard in the config and the stacking-limit
- **DTI-permit-lapse risk**: the coupon launches without the DTI permit; mitigated by the permit-gate in the design workflow
System Touchpoints: - Promo-rule engine (links to VS-29 / W300 promo-rule master, VS-14 / W13 promotions, VS-57 / W2223 promo pricing) — the coupon configuration
- DTI permit (links to VS-22 / W868) — the "Per DTI Permit No." requirement
- Item/category master (links to VS-29 / W252, W290 category) — the eligible-SKU scope

steps.activity: Marketing Promotions Manager designs the coupon: discount type (PHP-off, %-off, BOGO), eligible SKUs/categories, min-spend, validity period, stacking rules, channel (POS/ecom/app), redemption limit per customer; configures in the promo-rule engine

Automation Opportunity: - Voucher auto-distributed per segment; claim-rate auto-tracked; kill-switch armed
Controls: - CTL-403 (voucher-distribution authorization); CTL-44 (voucher-count integrity); operational: VP Marketing sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Viral-over-distribution risk**: a voucher goes viral beyond the intended audience, exceeding the budget; mitigated by the redemption-cap and the kill-switch
- **Spam-perception risk**: over-distribution erodes the brand (customers tune out); mitigated by the frequency-cap and the relevance-targeting
System Touchpoints: - Digital channels (links to VS-14 / W142 social media, VS-75 app, VS-10 email) — the distribution channels
- CRM/CDP (links to VS-13 / W156 CDP, VS-126) — the segment targeting
- Coupon platform (links to VS-58 / W2238) — the voucher generation and tracking

steps.activity: Digital Marketing Manager distributes vouchers via email, app push, SMS, social media; targets segments per the campaign strategy; tracks distribution and claim rates

Automation Opportunity: - Print-quantity auto-estimated from the historical redemption rate; display-compliance auto-verified
Controls: - CTL-198: print/display-asset tracking; operational: Marketing Ops Manager display-compliance sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Print-waste risk**: over-printing creates waste (unpicked coupons discarded); mitigated by the print-quantity tied to the expected-redemption rate
- **Display-non-compliance risk**: stores don't display the coupons; mitigated by the display-compliance photo (the W2175 pattern)
System Touchpoints: - Print/distribution (links to VS-14 / W190 in-house design, VS-07 / W571 store comms) — the physical coupon logistics
- POS (links to VS-08 / W5B, W539 coupon processing) — the redemption
- Analytics (links to VS-27 / W113) — the pickup/redemption tracking

steps.activity: Marketing Ops Manager coordinates physical coupon production and in-store display: print, distribute to stores, display at entrance/aisle/checkout; tracks pickup and redemption

Automation Opportunity: - Liability auto-computed from issued-vs-redeemed; budget-burn auto-tracked
Controls: - CTL-403 (coupon-liability accuracy — links to VS-157); CTL-44 (issued-count integrity); operational: CFO monthly sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Liability-overstatement risk**: the coupon liability is overstated (assumes 100% redemption when the actual is 15%), tying up capital; mitigated by the expected-redemption-rate estimation (the PFRS 15 breakage approach)
- **Budget-overrun risk**: a viral campaign exceeds the budget; mitigated by the redemption-cap and the kill-switch
System Touchpoints: - Coupon liability (links to VS-17 / W28, VS-54 / W2156 breakage pattern, VS-157 / PFRS 15) — the unredeemed-coupon liability
- Budget (links to VS-17 / W26) — the promo-spend budget
- Coupon platform (links to VS-58 / W2238) — the issued-vs-redeemed count

steps.activity: Finance Manager sets the coupon budget per campaign; tracks the coupon liability (unredeemed coupons as a PFRS 15 liability); monitors the redemption rate vs. budget; flags over-budget campaigns

Automation Opportunity: - Vendor-reimbursement auto-calculated from the redemption count × agreed rate
Controls: - CTL-39: co-op/rebate accuracy; CTL-48 (rebate-dispute resolution); operational: VP Merchandising sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Funding-dispute risk**: the vendor disputes the redemption count or the reimbursement amount; mitigated by the CTL-48 dispute workflow and the redemption-evidence
- **Free-rider risk**: a vendor benefits from a category-wide coupon but funds only their SKUs; mitigated by the coupon-scope clarity (vendor-funded = vendor-SKUs-only)
System Touchpoints: - Co-op/rebate (links to VS-39 / W27, VS-14 / W149 bank/credit-card partnership pattern) — the vendor-funding terms
- Coupon platform (links to VS-58 / W2238) — the vendor-funded coupon config
- AP (links to VS-15 / W7) — the vendor reimbursement

steps.activity: Category Manager negotiates vendor-funded coupons: vendor funds the discount on their products; terms recorded in the co-op agreement; Finance tracks the vendor reimbursement

Automation Opportunity: - Multiplier auto-configured; liability-impact auto-computed; incremental-basket auto-measured
Controls: - CTL-403 (ensure controlled execution — Coupon & Voucher Creation & Distribution (PA-58.1).)
- CTL-403 (loyalty-liability accuracy — links to VS-13 / W104); operational: VP Marketing sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Liability-inflation risk**: the multiplier inflates the loyalty-point liability beyond the expected-redemption buffer; mitigated by the liability-impact pre-check

- **Cannibalization risk**: the multiplier pulls forward sales (customers buy during the multiplier what they'd have bought anyway), not incremental; mitigated by the incremental-basket analysis (vs. a baseline)
System Touchpoints: - Loyalty/liability (links to VS-13 / W17, W104 loyalty financial governance, VS-54 / W2156 breakage) — the point-multiplier's liability impact
- CRM/CDP (links to VS-13 / W156, VS-126) — the member targeting and communication
- Analytics (links to VS-27 / W113) — the incremental-basket measurement

steps.activity: Loyalty Program Manager configures the point-multiplier campaign (2x/3x points on eligible categories/days); communicates to the ~600K members; tracks the incremental basket and the loyalty-liability impact

Automation Opportunity: - Fraud-design checklist auto-applied per coupon; design-issues auto-flagged before launch
Controls: - CTL-403 (coupon-fraud-prevention — links to VS-125); operational: Loss Prevention Manager pre-launch sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Generic-code-fraud risk**: a generic coupon code is shared virally beyond the intended audience; mitigated by the unique-code-per-customer design
- **Stacking-abuse risk**: multiple coupons stacked to near-free transactions; mitigated by the stacking-cap and the margin-floor guard
System Touchpoints: - Coupon platform (links to VS-58 / W2238, VS-125 / W266 fraud) — the fraud-prevention config
- Fraud monitoring (links to VS-58 / W2249 redemption fraud) — the post-launch detection
- LP (links to VS-23 / W248) — the LP oversight

steps.activity: LP Analyst reviews each coupon design for fraud vectors: unique-code (not generic), per-customer-limit, expiry, channel-binding, stacking-cap; recommends design changes before launch

Automation Opportunity: - Dashboard auto-refreshed daily during the active period; underperformance auto-flagged
Controls: - CTL-403 (ensure controlled execution — Coupon & Voucher Creation & Distribution (PA-58.1).)
- Operational: VP Marketing daily review during active campaigns
Pain Points / Risks: - **Vanity-metric risk**: the dashboard shows distribution count (vanity) not redemption-derived ROI (substance); mitigated by the ROI-primary structure
- **Real-time-blindness risk**: a campaign underperforms but isn't detected until post-campaign; mitigated by the daily-during-active-period cadence
System Touchpoints: - Analytics/BI (links to VS-27 / W113, VS-58 / W2254 campaign ROI) — the performance dashboard
- Coupon platform (links to VS-58 / W2238) — the issued/claimed/redeemed data
- CRM (links to VS-13) — the segment response

steps.activity: Dashboard: distribution count, claim rate, redemption rate, ROI (incremental sales vs. coupon cost), channel split, segment response; daily during active period
